audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] writes "Alpha Strikes" (packet flagged it), and both spikes[2].text and mid claim Alpha Strike lets him "vanish out of your Q3 and even your R Fate Sealed mid-flight".
audit.why: The ability is Alpha Strike. What Riot's text supports is that it is a 20/19.5/19/18.5/18s teleport that makes him untargetable and is shortened by his basic attacks — so burst TIMED into it is wasted. Whether untargetability removes a knockup already applied, or interrupts Fate Sealed in flight, is not in the kit text, and the page asserted both.
audit.corrected: Real name, the 20s cooldown and the attack-based reduction stated; the unverifiable mid-flight cancel claims removed rather than reworded.
sources: packet suspectNames: wrote 'Alpha Strikes', looksLike 'alpha strike'

audit.whatIsWrong: Meditate is never mentioned in any field despite being his sustain and his most punishable button.
audit.why: Meditate is a 10s CHANNEL that restores health and reduces damage taken — and it pauses the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander. Any CC cancels a channel, so Yone's Q3 knockup deletes the heal outright. That is the one thing Yone reliably wins in this matchup and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Stated in mid, and the anti-heal consequence in spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appears anywhere on the page, and Highlander is described only through 'resets'.
audit.why: Highlander is 85s, grants move and attack speed, and makes him IMMUNE TO ALL SLOWS — which is why disengaging from him after 6 fails. Wuju Style adds true damage on a 14s window, so stacking armour does not answer him.
audit.corrected: Wrote 85s and the slow immunity into spikes[2].text and mid, and the true damage into spikes[1].text and late.
